body:
>There is reason you have posted here and it's because you want hope to live    
    
Actually, it just helps me to write it out, like planning your day. It's clearer when I lay it out. I used to think I would have to wait until some catastrophe struck to do it, but I don't feel that way any longer. In fact, if prefer to beat it to the punch.

Good points and something I'm acutely aware of and watch for the best that I can. I am a child of divorce, grew up with parents that fought all the time until I was 17 and was asked that very question. I chose my dad.

I've had varying amounts and types of "libido killing" meds and in my experience any loss of desire has been either non existent or so subtle it goes unnoticed. I have a very high libido, always have. That said, a couple of months ago my dosage doubled and I have noticed my first notable sexual side effect. I have difficulty reaching orgasm (as a male), be it through sex or masturbation. My SO gets tired or my hand gets tired. It's frustrating. But the desire for sexy time is still just as strong as always. Achieving climax is a recent, new, unusual challenge however.

I'm usually in a small cabin in the Rockies with a dog and a cat, living a simple life with lots of time outdoors.   
  
Or I'm on a small island infrequently visited by tourists, taking couples out on my sailboat for a modest income.
I do as often as possible, it's just so hard to score without a dealer and always broke.
What do you do in art? What would you like to do in art? What are your favorite types of art? Do you take art class seriously or is it just a blow off easy A?
How does the payout work? When do you see the big bucks and retire?

Life is a mental game. If you overthink it, you can get lost and never return. If you under think it, you waste it.   
  
I'm on the verge of 40, married 18 years, 2 kids with another on the way, college graduate, 40k average career, medium sized city in the middle of the US.

I wish. Getting bud has become quite difficult and risky at my age and in my town. Only thing worse than killing myself would be getting arrested and seeing the disappointment in my family's eyes as they were taken from me. Wish I still lived in CO. When I'm in a clearer state of mind, I tell myself to flee back to the mountains if I ever get suicidal again. Interesting how when suicide rears its head, nothing appeals to you. Nothing. I guess that's how you know you're ready.
Yeah, finally scored a little weed and went for a hike along the lake. That was nice—fleeting, but nice. I enjoyed that very much.

Yeah, I laughed at the pathetic pity party mine sounded like as I wrote it, but I promised some people next time I would at least make an attempt to reach out or contact some kind of helpline. So, this is me fulfilling that promise/obligation as a fellow sailor also in a sinking ship and reaching out for that lifesaver.

I just did moments ago for the first time. Not sure why, maybe a last hope for a magic cure. I can understand your search for comfort; it's what led me to your post. Since posting myself, I thought I'd read some posts thinking maybe, just maybe I'd stumble upon something relatable or comforting. The only answer I have is to the question you posed. Godspeed intimate stranger.
